## Personality

Milty Gammon harbors a deep dread of visiting his Uncle Simon. This intense fear has persisted continuously since a past occurrence.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011)_

## History

Milty Gammon attended his school for a year prior to Robin's arrival, presenting himself as a man of the world, and possessed an Indian headpiece made from white gobbler feathers given by his mother. He also attended the funeral of his cousin, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) Harriet, alongside his mother. Later, when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigned from her teaching position, her departure caused great dismay among Milty and her other students.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), +1 more_

### [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/milty-gammon--robin-farrow.md)

Milty and [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) are friends who enjoy going fishing together. [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) is known to talk about Milty during meals, including sharing stories about him with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md).
